name: Claude Desktop
notes: Plugins: Cowork keeps its own store under local-agent-mode-sessions/<account>/<org>/cowork_plugins (the staged marketplace is copied in, plugins are recorded in installed_plugins.json and enabled in cowork_settings.json); new Cowork sessions pick them up. MCP: the local config accepts only stdio servers, so remote servers are installed as crewkit-bridge entries; restart the app to pick up changes. The Microsoft Store (MSIX) build lives under its package-family dir and reads its data from the virtualized LocalCache, not the real %APPDATA% — Paths::claude_desktop_dir picks the right one.
